question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

At cross purposes
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Disagreeing with each other's ideas.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**At cross purposes**" is an idiom that means to have conflicting or opposing goals or intentions. (परस्पर विरोधी या विरोधी लक्ष्य या इरादे रखना)

 
 
• Example: *Their conversation was at cross purposes because she thought they were discussing a business proposal, while he believed they were talking about vacation plans.*
 
 
 
• When people are "**at cross purposes,**" they are not working together effectively because they are not on the same page.
 
• In this context, the idiom suggests that the people involved are **not agreeing with each other's ideas** and may be working against each other.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
